reason: 该插件的核心用途是为 DSH 提供 Windows 桌面与 UI 自动化能力：通过 web profile 的 host 插件接口 (/api/screen) 提供截屏、OCR、鼠标与键盘操作，README 还明确包含画图控制相关流程，因此按用户交互自动化而非内容生成或研究工具分类。

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DSH 提供 Windows 桌面自动化能力，可进行屏幕截图与本地 OCR 识别，并支持坐标化鼠标操作、按键输入及画图流程控制。
summaries.en: This plugin adds Windows desktop automation to DSH, providing screenshot and local OCR capabilities, coordinate-based mouse actions, keyboard input, and Paint workflow control.

reasons.code: README states the plugin is a DSH host plugin for automation with /api/screen operations including capture, ocr, mouse click/double/right/drag, type, and key actions.
Repository and package metadata describe a Windows desktop automation plugin with host entrypoint and bundle patch for plugin loading.
Repository description explicitly lists screen capture, OCR, mouse/keyboard control, and Paint drawing capabilities.
